# Tellius

> Tellius is an agentic analytics platform that combines conversational AI, intelligent agents, and data integration to enable enterprise teams to make faster, more confident decisions through natural language queries and automated analytics workflows.

Tellius provides AI-powered analytics solutions across multiple industries including pharma, CPG, healthcare, financial services, and software. The platform leverages generative AI, RAG, and agentic flows to deliver self-service analytics and actionable insights from unified enterprise data.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- Agentic Analytics
- Conversational Analytics
- Generative AI
- RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
- Data Integration
- Semantic Layer
- AI Insights
- Root Cause Analysis
- Self-Service Analytics
- Enterprise Data
- Business Intelligence
- Data Unification
- AutoML
- Agentic Flows

- [Tellius Homepage](https://www.tellius.com): Tellius homepage showcasing AI agents for enterprise analytics workflows

## Core Platform Features

- [Conversational Analytics](https://www.tellius.com/platform/conversational-analytics): Conversational analytics feature enabling natural language queries
- [Connect Any Data](https://www.tellius.com/platform/connect): Data integration and unification feature with semantic layer
- [AI Insights](https://www.tellius.com/platform/ai-insights): AI Insights feature for root cause and anomaly detection
- [Interactive Visualizations](https://www.tellius.com/platform/visualizations): Data visualization and dashboard feature with AI-driven insights
